data.body: S2d (cd12-2815-d2ab-430a) plan-review: BLOCK x5 rounds remediated -> PASS/certified (verified_at_sha 8fa8f36b). Blocking findings fixed: (1) enumerate out-of-directory help consumers (gen_cli_reference.py + docs drift gate + overview/exit-code/schema tests); (2) correct ladder_intercepts attribution (lives in gen_cli_reference.py:305, parses __init__.py source); (3) split literal-Usage-prefix consumers vs subcommand_help() body-content consumers; (4) declare help/*.txt BODIES an APPROVED regeneration delta (committed bodies stale vs true factory grammar: show.txt has --no-pull absent from build_show, etc.) with factory enrichment (help=/description/epilog/SUPPRESS) as the home for curated prose; (5) description-length trim <8000; (6) --check must fail on blank overview one-liner; (7) add 2 production subcommand_help() runtime sites (bridge bare-invocation stdout, reopen no-args stderr). file_impact grew 8->24 paths. Claimed S2d. Remaining advisory: ac-quality 0.4 (justified skip). Next: held-out TDD.
